The question asks for the last prose book written by W. H. Auden, who referred to Wyndham Lewis as "that lonely old volcano of the Right." The predicted answer says "A Certain World: A Commonplace Book (1970)," while the ground truth answer is "Forewords and Afterwords (1973)." The two titles and publication years are different. "Forewords and Afterwords" was published after "A Certain World" and is thus correctly identified as Auden's last prose book.
